description: Relight a whole SCENE of a sequence: turn day into night, give a grey day a mood (golden hour, blue hour, storm, mist, warm evening) or add rain/snow — performance, camera and sound stay. Works on the video clips of the chosen shots (shot_ids, or scene_ref, or the whole sequence) and returns a NEW sequence version (Fassung) in which only those clips are swapped; the original sequence is never changed. MONEY: aktion 'preis' (the default) is free and returns the credits; quote them and wait for the person's yes, then call aktion 'starten' with max_credits. Never retry a paid run automatically. engine 'beeble' is for everyone; 'tein' (Seedance 2.5 edit, faces allowed) is admin-only on the admin's own material and runs as a 480p draft that 'finalisieren' renders in 1080p. 'stand' polls a run (lauf_id); 'neuversuch' redoes one failed or flagged clip once (clip_id, price first with get_cost).

aktion.description: What to do. Default 'preis' (free). 'starten' needs max_credits; 'stand', 'neuversuch' and 'finalisieren' need lauf_id.

aufloesung.description: Beeble output tier; tein always drafts in 480p.

engine.description: Default 'beeble'. 'tein' only for admins on their own material.

get_cost.description: With 'neuversuch'/'finalisieren': return the price only, charge nothing.

max_credits.description: Credits the person confirmed; required for 'starten', 'neuversuch' and 'finalisieren'. Refused if the server price is higher.

nur_eigene_daten.description: Only for a model that sends inputs to China or a US recipient without a documented basis, when the step carries images, clips, voices or faces. Means: this material shows or contains no real person other than the human using this account. Set it ONLY after the human has said exactly that for THIS step; never assume it, never reuse it for the next step. Not needed when the human has declared this material in the FilmLab app: the backend reads that declaration, also for material derived from it; only the app can store one. An LK reference, a licensed likeness or another person's agreement does not replace it. Without it the backend refuses with drittland_dritte_gesperrt before any charge; then use a non-gated model or text only.

referenzbild_id.description: Gallery image id (positive integer string) showing how the result should look, e.g. the first frame already in rain. Sent to the engine as a reference image — use it when text alone does not bring weather into the picture (falling rain did not appear from text alone).

scene_ref.description: Relight all shots with this scene_ref.

sequence_id.description: Sequence id (positive integer string); required for 'preis' and 'starten'.

shot_ids.description: Shots to relight. Omit to use scene_ref, or the whole sequence.

tageszeit.description: Light/mood preset. Give this, wetter, or freitext.

variante.description: Weather variant: regen niesel|stark, schnee fallend|liegend.

wetter.description: Weather, combinable with tageszeit (e.g. night + rain).
